profiles.name: homelab

files.content:
Host staging.internal.example.com staging testing.internal.example.com testing
    IdentityFile /root/.ssh/id_ed25519

Host production.example.com production
    IdentityFile /root/.ssh/id_ed25519_prod

Host *
    User agent
    BatchMode yes
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    StrictHostKeyChecking yes
    UserKnownHostsFile /root/.ssh/known_hosts
    GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null
    LogLevel ERROR
    ForwardAgent no
    ClearAllForwardings yes
    ControlMaster no
    ControlPath none
    ServerAliveInterval 15
    ServerAliveCountMax 3

promptGuidance: openssl is absent from the VM image

profiles.name: dbuild
promptGuidance: The dbuild CLI from daemonless.io is FreeBSD-specific and is not installed in this Linux image by default. Use buildah, podman, and skopeo for daemonless OCI work, or provide a Linux dbuild binary via postBuild commands.
